product.olivetti-m6-540.summary: The DX member of the Micro Channel M6 series.
product.olivetti-m6-540.history: Olivetti documented three Micro Channel M6 models. Markings on the BA2096 and BA2097 boards link their manufacture to Reply.
product.olivetti-m6-540.architecture: The motherboard handles video and storage. It integrates ATI 68800 graphics and NCR53C700-66 SCSI. The processor occupies the OverDrive socket.
product.olivetti-m6-540.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-540.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-540.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 3
product.olivetti-m6-540.reply-board: Ardent Tool, Olivetti M6-5x0 board photographs and markings
product.olivetti-m6-540.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists R1.47.36.
